Under Mocha, that means `TopicView.new` will return `nil`, so `@topic_view` becomes nil in `EmbedController#best`. Because controller specs typically do not render views unless `render_views` is enabled, this test only proves the constructor was invoked and does not exercise the `best.html.erb` code path that depends on a real `@topic_view` (e.g., `@topic_view.posts`, `@topic_view.topic`).
